maddeler.e:
ننتسب (form VIII)
# نَنْتَسِبُ (nantasibu) /nan.ta.si.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَسَبَ (intasaba)
# نَنْتَسِبَ (nantasiba) /nan.ta.si.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَسَبَ (intasaba)
# نَنْتَسِبْ (nantasib) /nan.ta.sib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَسَبَ (intasaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
